name: Eso Es
positioning: Not an agency. A leak plugger.
core_metaphor: Every business has leaks — missed calls, weak visibility, no follow-up, no systems. Eso Es finds the leaks and plugs them.

pain_points: Random follow-up or none at all

Gotcha.what: Instant missed-call text-back system for local businesses
Gotcha.pain: Missed calls walk out the door and call the next business on Google
Gotcha.outcome: Customer captured before they go cold

Ripple.what: Local visibility cleanup — Google, reviews, promos, follow-up
Ripple.pain: Being good at the work doesn't help if people can't find you
Ripple.outcome: Local customers can find you, trust you, and contact you

Frother.tagline: Tap in. Stack stamps. Froth on.
Frother.what: Digital loyalty and promos for cafes, pubs, restaurants, takeaways, local venues
Frother.pain: New customers are expensive. Regulars are gold. Paper stamp cards don't work.
Frother.outcome: Regulars come back more often without any paper or app download nonsense

WSUP.what: SOPs, checklists, staff guides, workflow maps — gets the business out of the owner's head
WSUP.pain: If your business can't run without you explaining everything, you own a job with witnesses
WSUP.outcome: Team can find procedures, train properly, and run the business without the owner's brain
